texts.preamble: Vikas Mohan Goel vs State Of Up And Another on 15 March, 2024 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:46679 Court No. - 93 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 689 of 2024 Applicant :- Vikas Mohan Goel Opposite Party :- State Of Up And Another Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J. 1. 2. texts.arguments: 3. The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the cognizance is barred by Section 200 Cr.P.C. because the cognizance was taken only on the basis of complaint without examining the complainant. 4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that if a complaint is filed by a public servant, then there is no need to examine the complainant. Section 200 Cr.P.C. is very clear that if the complaint is filed by a public servant in discharge of his official duty, then the Magistrate need not examine the complainant and the witnesses and the regular proceeding of Section 200 Cr.P.C. does not apply in such cases. 7.
